plan.sentence: Buy only after a daily close above +4.7% from the Nov 2 close, up to +5.2%. Target +7.2%. Once in, out on a close below +3.3%.
plan.why_t1: the Jun 3–Sep 3 advance repeated from the Oct 1 low

standouts.head: MACD positive
standouts.text: MACD is above its signal line and above zero, with the histogram rising.
standouts.learn: The gap between a fast and a slow average of price; a cross up through its signal says momentum is turning.

against.head: A thin rise
against.text: Volume on the current rise runs 35% below its 50-day average: few buyers behind it.
against.learn: A rise on heavy volume has buyers behind it; a thin rise often fades.

against.head: Weekly: a pullback that is not done
against.text: The pullback from the Aug 31 high is not done: it has not reached the 0.5 retracement, it is one straight leg, it is too quick for the advance before it and selling volume is rising. A wave 2 usually unfolds in three waves and reaches the 0.618–0.786 of the Mar 20, 2023–Aug 31 advance (−29% to −38%).
against.learn: A real wave 2 takes three waves and time, on lighter volume. Too shallow, too quick, one straight leg or rising selling says it has further to go.

material.head: Weekly chart: advancing
material.text: Price is above a rising 30-week average: the advancing stage.
material.learn: Stocks cycle through basing, advancing, topping and declining; longs pay in the advancing stage.

material.head: Broke out of a 4-week base
material.text: On Nov 2 it closed above the base's top (6% deep), on 1.2x average volume, lighter than a strong breakout carries. The break session closed 0.1 ATR past the line on a 0.9-ATR range.
material.learn: A close above a ceiling that capped price before; strongest on heavy volume.

material.head: Buyers stepping in earlier (weekly)
material.text: Weekly: a higher low in price (the week of Sep 28) against a lower low in momentum (4 of 7 gauges): hidden bullish divergence.
material.learn: Higher price lows while momentum sets lower lows: buyers stepped in earlier, a common sign the uptrend resumes.

material.head: Support −0.7% below
material.text: The nearest floor is −0.7% below (0.6 ATR), where 5 levels (3 kinds) meet: the December 2025 breakout level, the 50-day average and the 50% retracement of the Sep 3–Oct 1 drop.
material.learn: A price where buyers stepped in before.

material.head: Reclaimed its 50-day average
material.text: It closed back above its 50-day average in the last three sessions.
material.learn: The average close of the last 20, 50 or 200 sessions; rising averages mark uptrends and often act as support.

against.head: Momentum stuck in a bear range
against.text: RSI has failed below 60 on every bounce for three months and fell to 28: the range momentum holds in a downtrend.
against.learn: In uptrends RSI tends to hold 40 on dips and reach 70; in downtrends it fails near 60 and reaches 30.

against.head: Weekly: a pullback that is not done

material.head: Strong uptrend (ADX 30)
material.text: Trend strength (ADX) reads 30, above the 25 that marks a strong trend, with buyers in control of the directional lines.
material.learn: A 0-100 gauge of trend strength, not direction; above 25 is a strong trend.
